text:
maria_li: FYI scheduling maintenance window for runtime patching tonight 2024-05-31 22:00-23:30 UTC. Will affect Hosted inference endpoints in eu-west-1 for ~45m, Dedicated customers may see brief pin fallbacks.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @maria_li at 2024-05-31T22:00Z. Plan: 1) drain hosts; 2) apply kernel/security patch; 3) run smoke + perf tests; 4) undrain. Auto-rollback threshold: error rate > 3% or tail latency > 2x baseline for 5m.

samir_cs: Can we get a short customer-facing blurb for email + statuspage? Keep it simple, one paragraph.

maria_li: Draft for review — pls edit inline: "We will perform scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 on 31 May 2024 at 22:00 UTC. Expected impact: ~45 minutes of reduced throughput while updates are applied; requests may be routed to fallback model variants. Pinned model versions are preserved where possible; brief 503s may occur if pinned versions are incompatible with fallbacks. No data will be lost. Support: support@redwood.ai."

elaine_prod: Two suggested edits: 1) call out affected services (Hosted API - eu-west-1). 2) add note to Dedicated customers to expect maintenance if they have non-ha pools.

raj_oncall: For statuspage we should use component: "Hosted API (eu-west-1)" and template = "scheduled-maintenance". I'll post 10m before window. Also calling out "If you rely on model pinning, consider enabling auto-fallback during the window" is helpful.

samir_cs: Love it. Add support link and phone line for enterprise customers. Also add short subject line for email: "Scheduled maintenance — Hosted API (eu-west-1) — 31 May"

maria_li: Final customer blurb (ready for copy): "Scheduled maintenance: Hosted API (eu-west-1) — 31 May 2024, 22:00 UTC. We will apply runtime updates to improve reliability. You may see reduced throughput or brief errors for ~45 minutes while traffic is drained and services are updated. Pinned model versions are preserved where possible; in rare cases pinned versions may cause short 503s if fallback routing is required. If you need assistance, contact support@redwood.ai or your account team."

deploy-bot: Step 1 started: draining pool-eu-a (12 hosts). Logs: ```drain --pool pool-eu-a --grace 60s```

raj_oncall: Draft statuspage message prepared. Will post at 21:50 UTC (10m before). Link preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/<generated-id>

samir_cs: Email sent to affected customer list (enterprise + paid Dedicated). Template: short blurb + link to statuspage + support contact.

maria_li: Quick ops note — for Dedicated customers with pinned non-HA nodes, ops will coordinate directly. We will avoid forced restarts where possible; if a restart is unavoidable we'll try to minimize impact and notify account owners.

elaine_prod: Add one-liner for release notes: "Runtime security and stability patch — no API changes."

deploy-bot: Smoke tests running against canary after patch (canary-eu-1). Current: 0 failures / 1200 reqs, median latency +5ms vs baseline.

raj_oncall: Posted to statuspage at 21:50 UTC: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/<generated-id> — using component Hosted API (eu-west-1).

maria_li: Ops update: patch applied to pool-eu-a, rolling to pool-eu-b now. Will monitor for errors and rollback if thresholds exceeded.

deploy-bot: If rollback triggered, action will be: 1) pin traffic to previous runtime image; 2) restart affected hosts from pinned image; 3) run validation. Rollback command: ```rollback-runtime --pool <pool> --image <previous> --reason "post-patch errors"```

samir_cs: Support note: CS outreach in progress to top 15 accounts, CS lead on call.

raj_oncall: All clear now — smoke + perf pass across pools. Keeping monitoring for 30m. Will close statuspage once stable. :white_check_mark: 

maria_li: After-action: please add a short incident note if any customers reported impact. Otherwise we'll close and include this in the weekly maintenance digest. Thanks all.
